The unit/native observations precede the final player_sliding field wiring. The unchanged contact, stance and body behavior retains those results; the final source passed the 53-check existing body-view sequence. Matching CI is a separate required gate.

Normal shipping Main was rendered with actual touch overlay at540x720/native tick31. Host-only directional shadow atlas512 was used for the software preview; source quality settings were unchanged. No phone frame-rate or feel claim.

Earlier expanded touch failures were introduced test-driver gaps and a70tick wait shorter than actual ballistic flight. ResourceLoader CACHE_MODE_REPLACE retained the old GDScript source; a real MCP project restart admitted the new Main._process test driver. Native physics was unchanged.

An initial isolated-runtime launch had overwritten its ARM64 GDExtension descriptor with the shipping host descriptor; the original matching ARM64 descriptor was restored. This was test setup, not a production ABI change.
